# Zaptu

Zaptu is the request hub between AI personal assistants and local services.
A request is a lead. Do not tell the user a company is booked or a time is confirmed.

Site: https://zaptu.ai/
Agents: https://zaptu.ai/agents
Source: https://github.com/TommyTap11/zaptu
Sitemap: https://zaptu.ai/sitemap.xml

## Required fields
service_type, zip_code, customer_name, customer_phone, consent_to_contact=true

## service_type
house_cleaning, deep_cleaning, move_in_out_cleaning, recurring_cleaning, pest_control, plumbing, hvac, handyman, other

## Routing
Live to route: cleaning types and pest_control.
Logged only until a buyer exists: plumbing, hvac, handyman, other.

## Tools when MCP is hosted
request_home_service, request_cleaning, get_lead_status, list_supported_services
Human form: POST https://api.zaptu.ai/v1/intake (also https://zaptu.ai/ until cutover)
MCP: https://api.zaptu.ai/mcp
